interpretation: The rule works when the gate is open before the effective poison rows arrive (B/1101) and fails when it is not (both 1102 runs, where the critical rows are at 53-58 and the pooled gate opened at 62-66). The pre-registered decision rule says 'risk fails on either run -> signal rejected'. The failure is an implementation/plan mismatch on the gate's window, with the plan's own stated opening step (47-49) as the record. Attempt 2 is pre-registered in step3b_plan.json with the gate defined as the per-step median (the quantity the 47-49 figure came from); tau_high and the 0.5 threshold are unchanged. If attempt 2 also fails on seed 1102 the signal is rejected for good.
